body.name: baseline_gauge
body.def: The lift \(\overline\beta_{\theta i}(t)=\int_0^tq_i^0(s)ds\) obeys \(\overline\beta_{\theta i}(t+2\pi)=\overline\beta_{\theta i}(t)+2\pi\) and \(\overline\beta_{\theta i}'=q_i^0>0\); hence \(\beta_{\theta i}=\overline\beta_{\theta i}\pmod{2\pi}\) is an orientation-preserving degree-one circle diffeomorphism carrying \(q_i^0d\lambda\) to \(d\lambda\).
